label: weak, sparse copy-phase feature loosely tied to input v
explanation: Very sparse (0.018% of steps), low-magnitude feature (max 0.17). 96% of mass is in the copy phase, concentrated at later recall positions (recall_idx 3-5, to_go <= 2); it never fires on the delimiter or at t < 3. About half the mass is on steps whose input is v (16x lift), with smaller lifts for input 3/p/e/w and for outputs v/g/e. Repeated tokens raise the rate somewhat (in_count >= 2). Even so, only about 0.6% of copy-phase v-input steps activate, and every refinement tried (v->v, repeated v, late position, output set) stays below 8% precision. No coherent predicate captures when it fires. The predicate given is the best simple descriptor (dev recall 0.50, precision 0.006). It is not an explanation.
